native_call_paths.behavior: Local captions-only i18n-sheet -> replace selected worksheet texts -> native i18n-merge. Null means success. It does not dispatch a translation model and does not enforce max_chars itself.
Native retry router; keeps actual request IDs and local taking/taken/sent/refused recovery behavior.
Free preflight -> actual report/ACK of same request ID as taken -> only then native counter reset and local taking -> startDubRetry.
Only native lifecycle removes skipped.json, records taken, and invokes makeDub.
Normal synthesis/fit/ASR/Jev, shortening/retake/reword limits, STOP, leases and uncertain/pending receipts remain in force.
A reported skipped dub closes only a TAKEN request. Merely REQUESTED remains requested. A ready result can close a real open request, so ready must never be inferred from text review.

ko.scope: Six source-meaning-reviewed text proposals only, not audio approval.

minimum_future_sequence.action: Require a genuine owner request and the real project lease.
guards: Actual fresh ProjectOut.dub_retries[locale] has the supplied same UUID, status=requested and open=true; do not synthesize or create a request from chat text or the status review.

Only ko/pt/id; exact saved eight-language choice; current remote final/publish identities approved and bound to genuine local final+QA. Preserve source speech, branding and actual status/evidence bindings.

Acquire the normal shared project lease without takeover. Re-read native state under it; honor STOP, blocked/dropped/tidied state, deferrals and existing receipts. Set flow.leases and actual ctx/env as existing helper does.

minimum_future_sequence.action: Validate the independently reviewed exact edit map before mutation.
guards: Original canonical translation SHA, source video SHA, baseline skip/fit/check/take hashes and proposal/review hashes must match the actual files.
Each before string and source cue must match. Allowed changed IDs are precisely the selected independently accepted lines; no metadata, chapters, primary text, voice or other locale changes.

mergeDubLines does not enforce budgets. Check Unicode counts against the independently reviewed caps, fresh native worksheet caps and actual fit.over max_chars when present; use the strictest applicable cap.

ID fit caps are f576ae=48, 9e738a=46, ed8308=63. Fresh native worksheet estimates are looser (65/58/82), so they must not replace those actual failed-fit caps. ID remains held until its rejected line has a faithful independently accepted replacement.

minimum_future_sequence.action: Create a work-only request-ID-bound merge receipt and apply through the native local merge.
minimum_future_sequence.call: await flow.mergeDubLines(state, locale, new Map(reviewedIdTextPairs), "independently reviewed owner-retry proposal")
guards: Before the merge, save actual request ID and original bytes/SHA, selected exact reviewed texts, review/proposal hashes, final/publish/choice identities and original failure evidence hashes in work/.
The helper must fence/check lease+STOP around this merge. Do not call rewordDub or shortenDub to apply held text; those would dispatch another paid model.

Require native merge return null. Check normalized before/after difference is exactly intended texts on selected IDs. Native i18n-merge supplies source_hash values; never hand-compute or relabel them.
Record actual merged canonical SHA. Skip markers, counters, existing clips/cache, old failure flags/checks and primary final/QA remain untouched at this boundary.

minimum_future_sequence.action: Fresh-read the same owner request after the local merge, then use the native retry router.
guards: The selected object is the actual backend entry, filtered only to choose one locale. Do not invent requested/open/taken fields or echo an unsupplied ID.
Require the same still-requested/open request ID and unchanged approved final/publish and saved choice; verify lease/STOP and merged SHA again.
If request vanished/expired/changed, stop before any take or paid work. Record merged-but-not-taken state; do not manufacture ACK, clear a skip or reset counters.

Let native takeDubRetry run packageRefusal, other ready/uploaded tracks checks, dry-run and missing-current-translation checks against the newly merged text. Native failures/refusals/deferrals keep their actual semantics.

minimum_future_sequence.action: Allow only the native taken ACK transition to reach paid production.
guards: Native report must return the same real request ID with status=taken. Null/no matching ACK is not authorization to fall through to makeDub.
Only after that actual ACK may native takeDubRetry/startDubRetry reset its retry rounds, set check_stopped, remove skipped.json and invoke makeDub. The wrapper must not duplicate those writes.
Keep normal fit/shortening/retake/reword limits and current native audio checks. An owner retry restarts rounds through that native state transition, not through an independent edit.

minimum_future_sequence.action: Resume from exact native and work receipts without re-merging or resetting.
guards: If canonical matches this request-bound merged receipt, verify it instead of blindly requiring/reapplying the old before SHA. A different source/output pauses for inspection.
Use dubRetries for native taking recovery: if skip still exists it repeats native guards/ACK; if skip is already gone it resumes native startDubRetry. Never recreate taking/taken markers manually.

For matching actual taken/open plus local taken and absent skip, dubRetries deliberately returns null; resume makeDub for the same request only when unfinished. Do not call takeDubRetry again to reset counters.
If a durable shortening/reword stage is pending, recover the exact saved job first using existing hash/GET-only recovery so an already-counted round is not incremented twice.

If a taken ACK response was lost before any local taking record, require the matching request-bound merge receipt and untouched original skip; let native retry handling reconfirm its actual ACK, never synthesize or create local state independently. Otherwise stop and inspect.

A current checked completed dub with its language round cleared needs no more synthesis; a new native skip also must not be retried again automatically. Both still need a truthful later language result batch.

source_and_cache_effects: Changing only target translated text through native merge does not change the zh-TW primary source/final approval; primary timeline speech_hash and local final/QA must still be verified unchanged.
The repaired target translation_hash and affected TTS request/cache keys change, intentionally making the old target assembled dub stale while its genuine skip remains until actual taken ACK.
Native takeDubRetry checks staleness of OTHER tracks that the server says ready/uploaded; target staleness itself is expected and is not a reason to bypass the native preflight.
Native dub reuses unaffected current takes and synthesizes changed request keys or recovers their exact genuine saved result. Old failed ASR/flags may not be relabeled as approval of amended text.
Dry-run may exit zero even while estimating overlong windows. Text length and estimates are not measured fit or audio quality; actual native synthesis, fit and ASR/Jev still decide.
result_batch_and_queue_risks: Native retry remains taken/open until its truthful later language batch (or native refusal). Do not interpret a local successful track as an owner Studio upload.

Do not rerun the frozen failure-status helper after an owner retry has been taken: restating that locale as skipped would close a TAKEN request as skipped. The existing helper already refuses open retries.

A later partial language batch replacing the current pending three-locale status must preserve other locales' actual states; superseding the old review with only one locale can otherwise remove its skip state from the UI.

Never restate an old skip for another locale whose retry is currently taken. Wait for its real result or omit its dub while preserving actual working state; do not close it through a status-only update.

No full package/publish or native language auto-push is planned here while EN is held and other components remain unfinished. Existing unchecked EN material must not become ready through a native dubsForUpload shortcut.
prohibited_helper_actions: Creating an owner retry request or substituting chat/status review for the actual queue entry
Direct skip removal, retry-counter reset/increment, or synthetic taken ACK
Applying the rejected ID 9e738a candidate or calling all ID3 approved
Changing primary source/voice/branding/gates, approving QA, recording Studio upload or publication
Treating a text review, old ASR wording, a dry-run estimate, or an existing failed WAV as a fresh passing audio result
Taking over an active project lease or bypassing STOP/durable uncertainty
next_action: Wait for actual owner request(s). Implement a narrowly scoped consumer only against supplied real request ID(s) and the then-current approved exact text set; no retry helper or API operation is authorized by writing this plan.
